blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) has arrested an officer of the Bureau of Immigration (BI) at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport (Naia) in Pasay City for allegedly being involved in a human trafficking scheme. In an interview on Thursday, NBI Director Melvin Matibag said the BI officer is supposedly connected to illegal recruiters who offer jobs abroad to applicants with insufficient documents. “Yung immigration officer, siya ’yung tinatawag na gunner. So sa kanya dadaan ’yan. Pero mayroon ding nagbi-brief. Ibi-brief ’yung mga supposed to be dadalhin for human trafficking. Then ’yung nag-book ng mga flight. Tapos merong […]...
